title: Trump Tried to Cripple Huawei. Now It Is Central to China’s A.I. Push.
headline: How U.S. Sanctions Failed to Stop Huawei’s Role in China’s AI Development
takeaway: Despite aggressive U.S. efforts to cripple its operations, Huawei has emerged as a central player in China's strategic push for artificial intelligence dominance.

title: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
headline: Nvidia Halts Chip Sales to Southeast Asia Amid New U.S. Export Rules
takeaway: New U.S. licensing requirements for advanced AI chips have forced Nvidia to suspend sales in four Southeast Asian countries, highlighting the global impact of tech export restrictions.

title: ‘The Digital Deficit Has Come Due’
headline: Cybersecurity Expert Warns That Flawed Software Makes the Internet Inherently Vulnerable
takeaway: Nicole Perlroth explains that the modern internet's susceptibility to outages and attacks stems from the fundamental, systemic use of faulty and insecure software code.

title: How Birds With GPS and Audio Sensors Track Hidden Fishing Boats
headline: Researchers Use GPS-Equipped Birds to Detect Illegal Fishing Vessels
takeaway: Equipping northern gannets with audio sensors and GPS trackers provides a novel, non-invasive method for monitoring and identifying hidden fishing activity in the North Atlantic.

title: After Cyberattacks and Bomb Threats Hit Europe, Survivalism Goes Mainstream
headline: European Governments Advise Citizens to Stockpile Supplies Amid Rising Security Threats
takeaway: Heightened concerns over cyberattacks and regional instability have led the German government to normalize survivalism by recommending that citizens maintain emergency supplies for extreme situations.

title: STAT+: FDA approves Cogent’s drug for rare stomach cancer
headline: FDA Approves Cogent Biosciences' New Stomach Cancer Treatment
takeaway: The FDA cleared Cogent’s drug Ekitna for rare stomach cancer, marking a significant regulatory milestone for combination therapies in oncology.

title: Orangutans face bleak future after Indonesia’s devastating wildfires
headline: Indonesian Wildfires Threaten Survival of Critically Endangered Bornean Orangutans
takeaway: Intensified El Niño-driven wildfires have devastated critical habitats, creating a dire outlook for the survival of the Bornean orangutan population.

title: Aaron Sorkin on Hollywood’s Vision of American Politics
headline: Aaron Sorkin Discusses Hollywood's Portrayal of American Politics
takeaway: The acclaimed writer reflects on his creative process and the intersection of political narrative and entertainment in modern American culture.

title: Europe looks beyond its giant telescope to its next big bet
headline: European Southern Observatory Plans Next-Generation Astronomical Instrument
takeaway: As the 39-meter telescope nears completion, the European Southern Observatory is evaluating proposals for its next major investment in advanced astronomical research infrastructure.
